name: Cortina d'Ampezzo
blurb: Groom the Olympia delle Tofane under the pink Dolomite walls before the 2026 Olympians drop in.

name: Bormio
blurb: The Stelvio: icy, dark and relentless — the men’s Olympic downhill needs a perfect surface.

name: Livigno
blurb: Sunny, high and wide open: keep Mottolino’s cruisers and famous snowpark in shape.

name: Breuil-Cervinia
blurb: Endless glacier highways beneath the Matterhorn — the Ventina alone is a marathon.

name: Zermatt
blurb: The Swiss side of the Matterhorn: Klein Matterhorn glacier, Gornergrat and Sunnegga, down to the car-free village.

name: Kitzbühel
blurb: Mausefalle, Steilhang, Hausbergkante: prepare the Streif, the most feared downhill on Earth.

name: St. Moritz
blurb: Champagne climate and Engadin sunshine on the slopes where alpine World Cups were born.

name: Aspen Mountain
blurb: No beginner runs, all attitude: Ajax’s steep fall-line groomers drop straight into town.

name: Val d'Isère
blurb: The Face de Bellevarde plunges 1000 m straight at the village — groom it for the Olympic legends.
